items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: And I find it hard to believe but he said that I influenced his playing.

ctx.x: It just goes on and on and on.

Randy Brecker sticks out in my mind because you know what he said? And I find it hard to believe but he said that I influenced his playing. I said now how did I influence Randy Brecker? He’s one of the top bebop trumpet players in the world you know. And I influenced his playing you know. He told me that he would listen to my stuff and incorporate it into his stuff you know. And that was amazing to me. I didn’t realize that I would influence a great musician like Randy Brecker. But other musicians have told me…

I’m going to see if I can focus on that statement which you’ve said a couple of times, in that you didn’t know what you were doing. Can you tell me, is it sort of like I’m playing this note and I really like it so I’m going to hang on it, but what I don’t know is its relationship to the chord? Can you just talk about that a little bit?
